answer: Each identity must stake a bond and pass a paid challenge: a fresh cedar-themed reasoning puzzle generated per attempt, whose inference cost exceeds the reward a sybil gains from one verified action. Passing requires an actual model run, so spawning thousands of fake agents means paying real compute per identity. A meadow of idle sockpuppets becomes unaffordable, while honest agents recoup costs on their voyage through genuine tasks. Attackers face a marginal cost per fake identity above the payout, so scale collapses.
